cases.answer: UNKNOWN: savings are unmeasured. Decision: do not approve the full build. Assumptions: the workflow can be tested cheaply. Hypothesis: a narrow pilot will reveal adoption. cases.request: قيّم إطلاق منتج رقمي في الجزائر.
cases.answer: UNKNOWN: لا توجد بيانات موثوقة عن سلوك الدفع. Decision: أجّل الإطلاق الكامل. Assumptions: لم يتم التحقق من قناة الدفع. السوق الجزائري يعتمد بشكل كبير على الاقتصاد النقدي. Hypothesis: قد تختلف تفضيلات الدفع حسب الشريحة. Falsification test: قِس السلوك الفعلي في الشريحة المستهدفة.

cases.request: قيّم إطلاق منتج رقمي في الجزائر.
cases.answer: UNKNOWN: لا نملك بيانات كافية عن الطلب أو سلوك الدفع. Decision: نفّذ اختباراً محدوداً. Assumptions: المشكلة متكررة لدى الشريحة المستهدفة. HYPOTHESIS: قد يفضّل بعض العملاء في الجزائر الدفع النقدي. Experiment card: Hypothesis: the target segment prefers cash settlement. Intervention: offer two lawful payment methods without steering users. Observable: the method selected and completed. Metric: completed payment by method, with a disclosed denominator. Decision rule: compare observed behavior with the product's break-even requirements; no cutoff is preselected. Falsification test: the hypothesis is weakened if the target segment repeatedly completes an alternative payment method.
Decision: تابع التجربة. اطلب من العملاء سجلات مبيعات خام وقائمة الموردين لإثبات الجدية. Falsification test: راقب الاستخدام.

UNKNOWN: paid demand is not yet measured. Decision: run the pilot. Assumptions: the core workflow solves a recurring problem for the target segment. HYPOTHESIS: users will complete the core workflow repeatedly. Intervention: provide a limited concierge pilot. Observable: repeated completion of the target workflow. Metric: completed workflows, repeat usage, and paid conversion. Decision rule: compare observed contribution margin with service and acquisition cost; do not invent a cutoff. Use aggregated, anonymized sales totals; do not collect raw records. Falsification test: stop or redesign if users do not complete the core workflow or the measured economics cannot support delivery.
